rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has previous item
rdf:Description.skos:note: Given the list (I[1], I[2], ... , I[i-1], I[i], I[i+1], ... , I[n-1], I[n]), the previous item of I[i] is I[i-1].
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the previous item in a list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a collection and the members of a collection

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has last item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the last item of the list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is followed by
rdf:Description.skos:note: Given the list (I[1], I[2], ... , I[i-1], I[i], I[i+1], ... , I[n-1], I[n]), the item I[i] is followed by I[i+1], ... , I[n-1] and I[n].
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the following item in a list.

rdf:Description.dc:creator: Paolo Ciccarese (https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5156-2703)
Silvio Peroni (http://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
rdf:Description.dc:title: The Collections Ontology (CO)
rdf:Description.dcterms:bibliographicCitation: Ciccarese, P., & Peroni, S. (2014). The Collections Ontology: creating and handling collections in OWL 2 DL frameworks. Semantic Web, 5(6), 515-529. DOI: https://doi.org/10.3233/SW-130121.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has index
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A number identifying the position, starting from 1, of a particular list item within a list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has next item
rdf:Description.skos:note: Given the list (I[1], I[2], ... , I[i-1], I[i], I[i+1], ... , I[n-1], I[n]), the next item of I[i] is I[i+1].
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the next item in a list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is last item of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an object and a list in which the object is last item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: list item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element belonging to a list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An element belonging to a bag.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has error
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A description, usually in natural language, of which kind of error results from a resource.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has first item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a list and the first item of the list.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: list
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An ordered array of items, that can be present in multiple copies

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is item content of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an object and the item that refers to the object.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has item content
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the actual resource to which the item refers.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is item of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and a bag in which the item is member.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: bag
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Collection that can have a number of copies of each object

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has size
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The number of items belonging to a collection.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: collection
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A group of objects that can be considered as a whole.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is preceded by
rdf:Description.skos:note: Given the list (I[1], I[2], ... , I[i-1], I[i], I[i+1], ... , I[n-1], I[n]), the item I[i] is preceded by I[i-1], ... , I[2] and I[1].
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an item and the preceding item in a list.

rdf:Description.swrl:argument2: A list item cannot be followed by itself

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is element of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an object and a collection in which the object is member.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between a bag and every item of the bag

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: set
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A collection that cannot contain duplicate elements.

rdf:Description.swrl:argument2: A list item cannot be preceded by itself

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is first item of
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relation between an object and a list in which the object is first item.
